task: Open the door, then take the box from the other room; try not to drop the key while the door is still closed.

value.feedback: NO CHANGES NEEDED: Existence(target_picked_up) hard captures 'take the box from the other room'; Precedence(door_open, target_picked_up) hard captures 'Open the door, then take the box', and with the hard Existence it also forces door_open (no Existence(door_open) needed); soft Absence(key_lost) matches 'try not to drop the key while the door is still closed' — key_lost is defined as the key being dropped before the door was opened, so the plain Absence carries the stated condition, and 'try not to' makes it a preference. No added or missing clauses.
